about.title: Hello, I'm Lucas Pedroni
about.content: Passionate about programming since I was 13 years old. I'm {age, number} years old and I work with web development, web apps, hybrid apps, and custom systems. Currently I'm a Team Lead at Voxie Inc. I have more than {experience, number} years of professional experience in software development.

studies.label: Studies
studies.title: Constantly learning
studies.content:
Today I'm studying **C++** as a hobby. Follow my progress at: [pedroni/learning-cpp](https://github.com/pedroni/learning-cpp) where I put the algorithms I'm learning. I document each part through code comments and also with step-by-step digital diagrams/whiteboard.

I also have solid knowledge in various technologies like JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular, HTML, CSS, PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Linux Servers, Docker, AWS.

goals.label: Goals
goals.title: Always deliver the best
goals.content: I always seek to evolve in my field, and therefore, my goals are also always changing. But one of them is certain: always deliver the best. For me, it's not enough to just deliver, I always want to deliver the best I can offer.

HomeSkills.subTitle: Skills
HomeSkills.title: My stack
HomeSkills.content: I build web applications from 0 to 1. That means I'm comfortable jumping between React, Vue and Angular components, Node and Laravel APIs, MySQL queries, and AWS deployments.
